title: Panel copy and flag descriptions have a length budget the tests enforce
goal: UX-PATTERNS says a panel carries at most one short line of text, yet video sections carry paragraphs, and flag descriptions run to 200 words. Nothing enforces it. Target: the user's mocks (docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html, video-shell.html, comp-video.html and the page named here) at their fidelity; runner-prompt rules on default config, side-by-side with the mock, labels-not-explanations and right-click apply. Ask throughout: would a Premiere editor get this, and is it easier here?
notes: Filed from the 2026-09-23 video audit in the intake window.
acceptance: Scripts/test.sh fails when a panel section string exceeds the budget (60 characters, tune with the user via a card) outside an allowlist that starts empty for video
Flag descriptions capped (e.g. 40 words) with a test
A list of every existing offender app-wide, the video ones fixed by the panel task, the rest filed
